purpose: controlled baseline stage 2 — re-inference with existing weights, both orderings, population (all labels + label_iou + injected truth, unmatched predictions, ObjectLab)
synthetic: injected errors on KITTI/COCO subsets; controlled, not human-adjudicated
code_state: run + analysis scripts uncommitted at run time (parent commits)

env_rules.group_C_note: original box_accuracy_eval_mc_ruler_self.json used reliability_profile_mc.json; this rerun does not

budget: k = max(1, floor(0.1 * AIDA findings)) per condition, same k for every method; fewer candidates than k -> denominator stays k
aggregation: existing_label_layer = per-seed mean over non-silent, non-missing_* conditions, then mean/sd across seeds; all_conditions_finding_unit includes missing_* (comparable with seeded P@10%); missing_layer separate budget
